summary.zh: 查看服务状态与部署日志

description.zh: 读取项目、服务、环境与部署状态，查看日志并触发重新部署。适合在手机上跟进后端服务。首次连接在浏览器完成 Railway 授权。
description.en: Read projects, services, environments, and deployment status, view logs, and trigger redeploys. Handy for following a backend service from a phone. Railway authorization happens in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Railway 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Railway and authorize on first connect
